newsitem.title: JAPAN: Canon says to raise group investment to Y200 bln.
newsitem.headline: Canon says to raise group investment to Y200 bln.

text.p: Japan"s top printer maker Canon Inc said on Wednesday that it plans to increase its group capital investment to 200 billion yen this calendar year, up from 176.4 billion in 1996.
Canon said in a statement that it also plans to increase its group research-and-development expenditure to 160 billion yen in 1997, up from 150.1 billion in 1996.

Canon earlier announced that its group net profit grew a dramatic 71.1 percent in 1996 from a year before to a record 94.2 billion yen, helped by the global boom in personal computers as well as the weaker yen.
The company forecast that group net profit would grow further to 100 billion yen this calendar year.
